title: Controlled-Minimax: Stabilizing Adversarial Optimization via Control Theory
abstract: arXiv:2610.12915v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Minimax optimization is fundamental to adversarial learning yet suffers from severe stability challenges, often manifesting as persistent limit cycles or divergence. This paper investigates these instabilities through the lens of continuous-time dynamical systems. By modeling training dynamics as a second-order Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), we rigorously identify the root cause of non-convergence: the problematic eigenstructure of the loss function's Hessian near equilibrium points. To address this, we introduce Controlled-Minimax, a novel stabilization framework that reformulates the optimization trajectory as a controllable physical system. Unlike heuristic regularization techniques, our approach derives a specific feedback controller that provides theoretical guarantees of local exponential stability, regardless of the underlying Hessian spectrum. translated_title: 受控极小极大：基于控制理论的对抗优化稳定化方法
translated_abstract: 极小极大优化是对抗学习的基石，然而其面临严重的稳定性挑战，常表现为持续的极限环或发散。本文从连续时间动力系统的视角研究了这些不稳定性。通过将训练动力学建模为二阶常微分方程（ODE），我们严格地识别出非收敛的根本原因：损失函数的Hessian矩阵在平衡点附近存在问题的特征结构。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Controlled-Minimax，一种新颖的稳定化框架，它将优化轨迹重新表述为一个可控的物理系统。与启发式正则化技术不同，我们的方法推导出一个特定的反馈控制器，无论底层Hessian谱如何，该控制器都能提供局部指数稳定性的理论保证。因此，我们的方法能够稳定传统方法难以处理的一般极小极大问题。
tldr: 本文将极小极大优化的训练过程建模为二阶常微分方程，揭示了Hessian矩阵特征结构导致非收敛的根本原因，并提出Controlled-Minimax框架，通过设计反馈控制器实现了与Hessian谱无关的局部指数稳定性理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper models minimax optimization as a second-order ODE to identify the Hessian eigenstructure as the root cause of non-convergence, and proposes Controlled-Minimax, a feedback control framework that theoretically guarantees local exponential stability regardless of the Hessian spectrum.
